definition_quote.value: 'Practice of occupational therapy' means the therapeutic use of everyday life activities with an individual: (i) that has or is at risk of developing an illness, injury, disease, disorder, condition, impairment, disability, activity limitation, or participation restriction; and (ii) to develop or restore the individual's ability to engage in everyday life activities by addressing physical, cognitive, mental wellness, psychosocial, sensory, or other aspects of the individual's performance.
definition_quote.quote: "Practice of occupational therapy" means the therapeutic use of everyday life activities with an individual: (i) that has or is at risk of developing an illness, injury, disease, disorder, condition, impairment, disability, activity limitation, or participation restriction; and (ii) to develop or restore the individual's ability to engage in everyday life activities by addressing physical, cognitive, mental wellness, psychosocial, sensory, or other aspects of the individual's performance.

ota_supervision_face_to_face_frequency.value: At least once every two weeks in person or by video conference, and at least one time every month in person.
ota_supervision_face_to_face_frequency.quote: meet face to face with the supervised occupational therapy assistant as often as necessary but at least once every two weeks in person or by video conference, and at least one time every month in person

ota_supervisor_client_review_frequency.value: At least once each month per client; if interval of care is once per month or less, at least once every four visits.
ota_supervisor_client_review_frequency.quote: meet with each client who has been referred to a supervised occupational therapy assistant at least once each month, to further assess the patient, evaluate the treatment, and modify the individual's treatment plan, except that if the interval of client care occurs one time per month or less, the occupational therapist shall meet with the client at least once every four visits

max_ota_per_supervising_ot.value: No more than two full-time OTAs at one time, or four part-time OTAs if combined hours do not exceed 40 hours per week, unless otherwise approved by the division in collaboration with the board.
max_ota_per_supervising_ot.quote: supervise no more than two full-time occupational therapy assistants at one time, or four part-time occupational therapy assistants if the combined work hours of the assistants do not exceed 40 hours per week, unless otherwise approved by the division in collaboration with the board
